headline: Pushpak Teja climbs to 80th on ARC-3

sections.text: Pushpak Teja gained 4.60 points to reach 33.57, moving from 862nd to 80th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
The climb takes Teja into the board’s top 100. The last of 19 public gold places is at 37.98.
